speaker: john_heminges
text: You are in the passage, which is the right room. The play did not need you. The reckoning does.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I came for the reckoning only. I waited here. I did not go into the yard.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Two Gents is at its end out there. It wants no dukes of yours. You have missed none that were yours.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The share is thirty-six shillings.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thirty-six. I will set it down as thirty-six. I will not set a coffer under it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Thursday, then. You were not there. You will want it plain.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The Inns filled three galleries. I drew no laugh.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: On this England.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: On this England. I had the roll the night before. The yard did not laugh.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You had nothing till the garden. You were to die at Ely House and rise a gardener. A laugh was never the bargain.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I will not say the boxes were better without you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then leave it unsaid. An unsaid thing is more use than a false comfort.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Your line reached Aldermanbury. Sir Thomas dead. Who pays.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Bryan and I will wait on my lord's people at Somerset House within the week, so the Christmas money is not stranded with a dead man's clerks.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Within the week. I did not ask you to settle a name in a passage.

speaker: george_bryan
text: And we will not. No man is going to be named while the yard is still emptying.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I came to give you three galleries and the want of a laugh. I did not come to be first on a paper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody is first today. The widow has the accounts before any of us has a name.

speaker: john_heminges
text: That is as much as the house in Holborn will bear, and as much as we will say here.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Thirty-six shillings. Do not spend them between this passage and your supper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not spend them. Broth, and evening prayer, and the money stays in the house.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The sun was down before five. There is no inn-yard this winter. The Mayor has seen to that. The house will be played cold.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not arguing with a mayor from a passage. She will have lit the hall candle at five.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then take the thirty-six and go, before one fact turns into a vote. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. All three of you.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Within the week. Not before we have stood at the door.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: If they ask you how Gaunt did, say the truth. No laugh. Three galleries.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will say it so, if the house asks. I think she will ask after the candle before she asks after the king.
